title: Wet Wet Wet - Love Is All Around (1994)

lines.l: Ein Ohrwurm von den Tokens, The Lion Sleeps Tonight.
Das 80er Mixtape um halb haben wir nachher, nach den News, hier sind die 90er.
Wet, wet, wet. Schönen guten Morgen euch.
Oh, I love you, I always will
My mind's made up by the way that I feel
There's no beginning, there'll be no end
Cause all my love, you can be a friend
My mind's made up by the way that I feel
There's no beginning, there'll be no end
Cause all my love, you can't defend
Oh, it's written in the wind, oh, everywhere I am
So if you really love me, love me, love me
Come on and let it show
Come on and let it show
Marktforschungsinstitute ermitteln gerade die Radionutzung in ganz Deutschland.
Wenn euer Telefon klingelt, macht einfach mit.
